notes.title: Update 3.0.6
notes.content:
[h1][b]Changelog[/b][/h1][h2]
[b]Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue and error that occurred when retrieving internal IDs during online ranking uploads[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where uploading online rankings could potentially overwrite other players’ times  [/p][/*][/list][p]This will take effect on the next initial time registration.[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where iOS could sometimes fail to connect online at startup[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where entering certain characters in the serial code would cause a crash[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where race clear status was not reflected correctly[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Removed the retry count setting for Single Rally  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Minor fix to grip handling during vehicle side slip  [/p][/*][/list][p]The minimum grip level has been slightly raised. Further fixes/adjustments will be made in v3.1.[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Class A vehicles had weak braking performance  [/p][/*][/list][p]All vehicles will be adjusted in v3.1.[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where terrain appeared to reflect unnaturally[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where terrain protruded into distant roads[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where lights did not reach long distances  [/p][/*][/list][p]The issue where lights do not illuminate the road is still under investigation.[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where performance became slower the longer you played[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Temporary fix for keyboard input not working on ChromeOS[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Major fixes to memory management[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Other minor fixes[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 3.0.5
notes.content:
[h1][b]Changelog[/b][/h1][h2]
[b]Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where errors could occur during UI navigation with a controller.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where these errors could result in excessive log traffic.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed button settings for left/right steering and gear up/down[/p][/*][/list][p]  Due to internal updates, the corresponding button assignments will be reset.[/p][list][*][p]Fixed rendering issues with decorative (prop) trucks on the Kaido map.[/p][/*][*][p]Applied a provisional fix for an issue where multiple ads could play simultaneously in the background.[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor fixes[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 3.0.2
notes.content:
[p]Update v3.0.2[/p][p] [/p][h1][b]Changelog[/b][/h1][p] [/p][h2][b]Changes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Restored grip during drifting to approximately 80% of the previous level[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Increased the threshold for grip break[/p][/*][/list][p]  Grip loss is now less likely to occur than before.[/p][list][*][p]Restored downforce values for nearly all vehicles to their previous levels[/p][/*][/list][p]  Grip during drifting has also been brought back to nearly the same as before.[/p][p]
[/p][h2][b]Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where an error could occur in Single Rally when finishing in 4th place or lower[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed display issues on the difficulty selection screen for 6.5-inch smartphones[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Windmills Hill where the vehicle could get stuck when respawning in the river during Free Run[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where steering assist was forcibly disabled during touch controls[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor fixes[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update v3.0
notes.content:
[p]Update v3.0.0[/p][p][/p][h1]Changelog[/h1][p][/p][h2]Additions[/h2][list][*][p]Added new game mode: Single Rally  [/p][/*][/list][p]  A mode optimized for the most efficient credit earning.[/p][list][*][p]Added new D1 class vehicle: EM1[/p][/*][*][p]Added new C1 class vehicle: LCP[/p][/*][*][p]Rebuilt the Windmill Hill course and its stages  [/p][/*][/list][p]  Includes 6 stages.[/p][list][*][p]Rankings reset due to incompatibility with rebuilt courses/stages  [/p][/*][/list][p]  Previous rankings will be archived.  [/p][p]  Going forward, rankings will reset only for courses that are rebuilt.[/p][p]
[/p][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Added vibration feedback for controllers  [/p][/*][/list][p]  Currently supported only on the Steam version.[/p][list][*][p]Removed Nordic Woodland and merged it into Nordic Lakeside due to asset limitations[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted overall rewards in conjunction with the implementation of Single Rally[/p][/*][*][p]BGM playback now separated for home and race screens[/p][/*][*][p]Increased stick rotation speed for the home screen camera[/p][/*][*][p]Changed course/stage/weather selection to proceed with a single input when using keyboard or controller[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced rain weather with snow for Nordic SnowFields and Winter Cliff[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the number of race opponents to 2[/p][/*][*][p]Players will now return to the course after deviating a certain distance off the road[/p][/*][*][p]Discontinued the K class and merged it into the E class[/p][/*][*][p]Moved FSZ to the X class[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted vehicle handling to allow for sliding under strong lateral G-forces[/p][/*][*][p]Increased headlight brightness for all vehicles[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the simulation accuracy for suspension impact on landing[/p][/*][*][p]Increased clutch sensitivity for all vehicles[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted gear change and clutch engagement times for all vehicles[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked aerodynamic properties across all vehicles[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted exhaust sounds globally[/p][/*][*][p]Performed global performance balancing[/p][/*][*][p]Temporarily disabled collision sounds due to internal collision handling issues[/p][/*][*][p]Added support for analog input (e.g., stick-type) in steering settings  [/p][/*][/list][p]  This reset all button assignments to default values.[/p][list][*][p]Removed "Default View" option from gameplay settings[/p][/*][*][p]Changed pace note call timing to a selectable setting[/p][/*][*][p]Renamed "Resolution" setting to "Resolution Scale"[/p][/*][*][p]Changed keybind settings display from two columns to one[/p][/*][*][p]Removed keyboard input support on smartphones  [/p][/*][/list][p]  Due to multiple issues with simultaneous inputs and hardware limitations, support has been discontinued to reduce maintenance costs.[/p][list][*][p]Added analog controller input support to Photo Mode  [/p][/*][/list][p]  Allows for more precise control.[/p][list][*][p]When using Photo Mode on smartphones, screenshots are now saved directly to the device without showing a share screen[/p][/*][*][p]Changed filenames of Photo Mode screenshots to date format[/p][/*][*][p]Removed save data migration support from v1  [/p][/*][/list][p]  Updating from v1 to v3 using old save data may result in corruption, and we do not guarantee proper operation.  [/p][p]  Corrupted save data will not be supported.[/p][list][*][p]In the Steam version, player names now default to the Steam username[/p][/*][*][p]Offensive terms in user or vehicle names will now be censored[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted post-processing effects[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized communication with the server for rankings and ghost data[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor adjustments[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed issue where gamepad inputs were treated as digital[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed "Back" button remaining visible even at the top of the home screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed reversed mouse wheel scroll direction on the course/stage/weather selection screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed forced scroll-back to previously tapped course in course/stage/weather selection[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed UI color for Vinyl 5 on WRB[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed internal errors caused by button mashing on certain screens[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where pausing could be triggered while adjusting settings[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed rapid item selection when using stick input[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed cars rolling on slopes before the race starts[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed rain continuing after switching back to the home screen from a race[/p][/*][*][p]Improved hit detection for vehicles on water surfaces and similar[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed submersion sound not respecting SE volume settings[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where the camera could no longer be changed partway through Kaido Stage 1[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed falling through terrain gaps in Winter Cliff[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Z-fighting (flickering from overlapping geometry) in Winter Cliff[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed behavior of up/down buttons in Photo Mode[/p][/*][*][p]Internal operation fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: N3Rally v3.0 Development in Progress
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
I'm currently working on N3Rally v3.0, aiming to release it around August.

This update will include a full rework of all stages, new game modes, new vehicles, and various optimizations—there’s a lot to look forward to.
The release date may shift depending on how development goes, but I’m posting regular progress updates on the official X (formerly Twitter) account and YouTube channel. If you're interested, feel free to check them out!

[*][url=https://www.youtube.com/@nae3na]YouTube[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: Update v2.1.6
notes.content:
Update v2.1.6

[h2]Changelog[/h2]


[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where keyboard inputs frequently failed to respond.
[*]Fixed an issue where pressing a control button while pausing would cause the button to remain pressed.
[*]Fixed an issue where skid marks remained after retrying or seeking in replays.
[*]Fixed an issue where brake lights sometimes did not turn on when braking.
[*]Adjusted the pace note offset so that the smaller the value, the faster the callouts.
[*]Fixed an issue where UI elements could be spammed using a controller.
[*]Fixed an issue where UI elements were not selected even when the mouse cursor hovered over them.
Course, stage, and weather selections are intentionally excluded from selection.
[*]Fixed an issue where the scroll bar was selectable when navigating the UI with directional keys, causing it to become unmovable when selected.
[*]Fixed an issue where buttons at the bottom of the car selection screen could not be selected using directional keys.
[*]Fixed an issue where the color selection in the custom settings for V1T did not match the actual car color.
[*]Fixed and modified BGM behavior.
[*]Fixed an issue where volume would not increase after launching the game with volume set to 0 and then raising it above 1.
[*]Fixed an issue in Photo Mode where taking a photo or canceling via key input was not possible.
[*]Fixed an issue where the camera could not be rotated using the keyboard or controller in the car selection screen.
[*]Various internal adjustments and fixes.
[*]Made various minor fixes.
[list]

notes.title: Update v2.1
notes.content:
Thank you for waiting! We've released [b]version 2.1[/b] with the key assignment feature.
Customize your key bindings for a more comfortable experience and enjoy the rally!

Update v2.1.0

[h2]Changelog[/h2]

[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added key binding functionality
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Separated keyboard controls and controller controls
[*]Changed keyboard controls to use the WASD keys.
[*]Updated other control keys.
Clutch: [Ctrl], Gear Shift: [J, U]
[*]Temporarily changed the controller notation in the rankings
Up to v2.0, ranking data for controller use was displayed with an icon that included both a keyboard and a controller. Starting from v2.1, it will be displayed with a controller-only icon.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the overall game volume was too loud.
The overall volume has been adjusted to half of the previous level.
[*]Fixed an issue where online connections were sometimes unavailable.
[*]Made various minor fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Begins!
notes.content:
'N3Rally' will launch in Early Access worldwide on January 10, 2025 (JST).  
It was a sudden announcement, but we hope you enjoy it!

The following updates are planned: 
[list]
[*]Key assignment functionality 
[*]Controller support
[*]Significant updates to certain courses (Nordic Woodland, Windmills Hill)
[*]Steering wheel controller support
[*]Display settings
[*]A new game mode
[*]Added achievements
[/list]
